title: Expand untrusted content adapter contract and fetch fixture
purpose: Turn the Alpha untrusted-content workflow into a typed content adapter contract with pinned local fixtures and future network fetch support.
scope: Define content fetch, content artifact, sanitizer, summary, and source-to-sink decision contracts.
Define pinned digest, maximum bytes, content type, origin label, and sanitization policy fields.
Define local fixture fetch as baseline and network fetch as optional integration.
Define denied action projection for injection attempts.
deliverables: runtime_contracts content adapter model additions or design doc
implementation_steps: Define content adapter contract fields and fixture shapes.
Specify local fixture fetch, digest mismatch, over-size, unsupported type, and injection cases.
Map summary outputs to replanning-only context.
acceptance_criteria: Digest and size limits are mandatory for fetch adapters.
Sanitized summaries cannot directly create tool calls.
Denied sink attempts are visible in audit projection without EffectPrepared.
verification: Run `cargo test -p security_execution source_to_sink` if policy code changes.
Run `cargo test -p agent_core untrusted_content` after workflow integration.
failure_modes: Network fetch becomes baseline acceptance dependency.
External content is treated as operator-trusted.
Summary text can drive privileged or exfiltration sinks.
Digest mismatch is warning-only instead of fail-closed.

blocked_until: Content adapter contract and fixtures are defined.
